Source: FILE_002 message table ranges (no database behind these)

en: Those Who Slither in the Dark

An institution devoted to the goddess. It both
guards and spreads the teachings of Saint Seiros.

A mighty region dominating the southern half of
Fódlan. Its history spans more than a millennium.

A land of kings and knights that sprawls across
the frigid northern reaches of Fódlan.

A region in east Fódlan with no crowned ruler,
but rather a roundtable of respected nobles.

A mysterious group working in the shadows
to sway the faith and leadership of Fódlan.

A mighty land to the east of Fódlan's Throat.
It has attacked Fódlan on many occasions.

A faction of the Church of Seiros that is situated
in western Fódlan.
All-purpose bait that often attracts everyday fish.
Live insect larva that Airmid pikes avoid.
Small fish filet that Airmid pikes avoid.
Freshwater snail that occasionally attracts uncommon fish.
Live bristle worm that Airmid pikes avoid.
Live pond snail that Airmid pikes avoid.
A wriggling bait, optimal for catching uncommon fish.
Live velvet shrimp that Airmid pikes avoid.
Live fiddler crab that Airmid pikes avoid.
Live earthworms that Airmid pikes avoid.
All-purpose bait that attracts somewhat unusual fish.
All-purpose bait that attracts somewhat unusual fish.
All-purpose bait that attracts somewhat unusual fish.

A favorable bait that is optimal for hooking extremely
rare fish.
Live pupa that Airmid pikes avoid.
Live grub that Airmid pikes avoid.
Live insects that Airmid gobies avoid.
Live blow flies that Airmid gobies avoid.
Nutritious squid-stuffed bait that attracts unusual fish.
Live small fish bait that attracts extremely rare fish.

This bait is used exclusively during the
fishing tournament.

Bait given to you by Flayn to catch your first fish!
Try it out at the fishing pond.

A handful of mixed herbal seeds. Plant them in the
greenhouse to see what becomes of them!
Mixed seeds foraged from the western region of Fódlan.

A sprinkling of mixed root vegetable seeds. You won't
know which types until you plant them.

These seeds have been gathered from the outer edges of
Red Canyon Zanado and will grow magical herbs.

Seeds gathered from a forest in the outskirts of Garreg
Mach. Optimal for growing a Noah tree.

Seeds derived from Albinean fruit. Planting them will
yield Albinean fruit.
Mixed vegetable seeds. Results may vary.
Mixed seeds foraged from the northern region of Fódlan.

Seeds derived from verona. Planting them will
yield more verona.

Seeds derived from Morfis plums. Planting them will
yield Morfis plums.
Mixed seeds foraged from the southern region of Fódlan.

Seeds derived from nordsalat. Planting them will
yield nordsalat.

Seeds derived from boa fruit. Planting them will yield
boa fruit.
A mixture of seeds that have been foraged from Albinea.

These mixed seeds have been gathered from the eastern
regions of Fódlan.

These seeds have been carefully extracted from
Magdred kirsch and will yield more of the delectable fruit.

Hand-selected seeds taken from the angelica plant.
Plant these to grow more angelica.

A mixture of various seeds. It's a mystery what they are
until they've fully sprouted!

Seeds carefully plucked from Albinean berries, which are
optimal for growing more of the same.
Rich red flowers sprout from these seeds when planted.
Bright white flowers will grow from these seeds.
A palmful of seeds that will grow bright blue flowers.
These seeds yield deep purple flowers.
A handful of seeds that grow vibrant yellow flowers.
Seeds that grow earthy green flowers.
These seeds yield brilliant, aqua flowers.

Seeds given to you by Dedue to grow a vegetable for him.
Try planting them in the greenhouse.

A basic smithing material. Can be used to repair
broken weapons.

A smithing material that strengthens a weapon's
critical attack.
A smithing material that is both light and durable.
A smithing material that glows with magical light.
A smithing material blessed with holy might.
A smithing material steeped in the power of darkness.
A smithing material refined using archaic methods.

A highly toxic smithing material that should be handled
with great care.
Ore used in the tutorial. Use it for trading.

A small fish found throughout the waters of Fódlan.
These fish can be eaten but aren't particularly tasty...

A hard-shelled edible crayfish that hides beneath pebbles
in rapid water. Can be used when you share a meal.

A stark white fish that gleams in sunlight. Can be used
when you share a meal.

A stately bearded fish from Lake Teutates. Can be used
when you share a meal.

This fish is commonly found in the Airmid River.
Can be used when you share a meal.

This fish has very hard scales, signifying its origins on the
Caledonian Plateau. Can be used when you share a meal.

A beautiful specimen, even among Teutates loaches.
Cook into a dish that boosts dexterity.

A fluid fish with armored scales that has existed for
millennia. Cook into a dish that boosts speed and defense.

This fish is a cross between loaches and pikes spawned in
Lake Teutates. Cook into a dish that boosts defense.

A shrimp with a shell hard as rock from Lake Teutates.
Cook into a dish that boosts defense and resistance.

This fish has a hard head that is used for defending itself
against predators. Cook into a dish that boosts speed.

An intense swimmer who migrates over vast distances near
the coast of Albinea. Can be used when you share a meal.
Glittering gold, this fish boasts a high cost.
This pricey fish shines like pure white silver.

Challenging to ensnare, this ancient fish has swum in the
waters of Fódlan for countless generations.

Appears only when the water shines with spectral light...
Cook into a dish that boosts dexterity, speed, and defense.
A somewhat costly fish that glimmers like polished silver.

This small fish is common to all regions of Fódlan.
It is somehow connected to Saint Cethleann.

A crop widely grown over all of Fódlan.
Often used as feed for calvary horses.

A crop that grows naturally all over Fódlan, which is often
used as feed for cavalry horses.

Sugarcane, a treat for cavalry horses that grows
throughout Fódlan.

Barley grass that grows throughout Fódlan and is used to
feed cavalry horses.

Common weeds. Not much to look at, and not of much
use either.

A simple fruit found in Zanado that is ill tasting and
inedible.
Parched vegetables that are no longer useful for cooking.

This rare fiery-colored grass thrives in the harsh
environs of Ailell and is sold for a high price.

A prized fruit as red as blood that grows in Zanado.
Cook into a dish that boosts magic and resistance.

A rare vegetable from Dagda that requires delicate
conditions to thrive. Can be used when you share a meal.

A fruit named after Saint Noa. It takes a skilled hand to
extract the pulp. Can be used when you share a meal.
Sweet peach currants. Can be used when you share a meal.

Blessed by the goddess herself, this vegetable is as tasty
as it is beautiful. Can be used when you share a meal.

It is said that mages of old infused these plums with their
spells. Cook into a dish that boosts luck.

A magical vegetable that grows in frigid, unyielding
environments. Cook into a dish that boosts charm.

Serpentine scales of this fruit protect the delectable pulp
nestled within. Cook into a dish that boosts resistance.

A shimmering fruit, warm and glowing with Magdred
magics. Can be cooked into a dish.

This unearthly vegetable is purportedly grown from the
blood of fallen heroes. Cook into a dish that boosts magic.

Simple Albinean berries that are tart with a hint of
sweetness. Can be used when you share a meal.

A Fódlan onion—a staple in many dishes. Can be used
when you share a meal.

A simple carrot grown in Fódlan that adds texture to
any recipe. Can be used when you share a meal.

A Fódlan turnip. Tasty and earthy. Can be used when you
share a meal.

Chickpeas harvested throughout Fódlan. Can be used
when you share a meal.

Cabbage of Fódlan that is enjoyed in a number of dishes.
Can be used when you share a meal.

This is the very first vegetable you acquired. It appears to
be a root vegetable.

Meat from birds hunted in the hills. Can be used when
you share a meal.

Meat from rabbits which are easy to hunt.
Used for cooking.
Fódlan pheasant meat. Cook into a dish that boosts luck.

Meat from foxes found in Gronder Field.
Cook with it to raise Charm.

Meat from beasts hunted in the hills. Can be used when
you share a meal.

Occasionally caught in a hunt, this meat is a bit hard to
come by. Cook with it to raise Str.

Prized grouse from the Oghma Mountains with a delicate
flavor. Cook into a dish that greatly boosts HP.

Meat from rare bears of Duscur with a dense flavor profile.
Cook into a dish that raises a unit's max HP.

This meat is taken from fleet-footed beasts found in the
Oghma Mountains. Cook into a dish that boosts strength.

Albinean moose meat—highly prized in Fódlan and rare to
find. Cook into a dish that raises max HP and strength.

A cut of rabbit meat that can be used to make a variety of
cooked dishes. These are easy to hunt down in the wild.

Fox meat hunted from Gronder Field that can be
cooked up.

Meat from the pheasants that live all across Fódlan.
Cook this into various dishes for a tasty meal.

The very first meat you acquired. It appears to be a type
of pheasant.

The bright notes of this tea stem from an infusion of citrus
oils. This blend is highly favored by nobility.

A tea blended with two types of apple peels. Elegant and
sweet, it is popular among common folk and nobles alike.

This tea is comprised of oxidized pine needles from eastern
Almyra, giving it a distinct, earthy tone.

Dried Albinean berries give this black tea its fragrance.
The sweet, relaxing scent is popular among many.

A blend with a unique dried fruit from the south. Popular
for its intoxicatingly strong, bright notes.

Black tea laced with rose petals. A classic floral blend often
enjoyed among Kingdom and Alliance nobles.

An invigorating mint blend that revitalizes and refreshes
all who partake.

Fermented dried seeds blended with tea leaves. It has a soft
and subtle flavor, akin to the gentle light of the moon.

A stark, bitter fruit from Dagda makes this black tea
particularly pungent. Connoisseurs enjoy its unique flavor.

A refined, nutty tea that is blended with leaves and thinly
sliced almonds.

A candied blend made up of dried, honeyed fruits.
For anyone with a sweet tooth, this tea can't be beat.

An aromatic bark blend referred to as the king of spices.
Its unique taste appeals to similarly unique people.

A black tea common to the south of Almyra, it is fairly
basic in its flavors. This is its common name in Fódlan.

A novelty tea blended with four unique spices inspired by
the Four Saints. Enjoyment requires a mature palate.

The sharp spiciness of ginger laces the body of this tea,
unforgettable and brightening.
A cleansing herbal tea blended with angelica.

Tiny dried purple lavandula flowers are sprinkled into
this refreshing floral tea.

A stark white floral tea with bright notes, this
blend calms the nerves and heightens concentration.

A high-quality blend of leaves procured specially for
House Hresvelg. Its refined flavor brings sheer bliss.

A specialty tea from the Alliance blended with a variety of
leaves from the east. This tea is of the utmost quality.

Even commoners have tried this cost-efficient tea,
which is a mixture of herbs. It's a tad bitter.
One Person's Trash is Another's Treasure
